response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_across_media_types FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.media_type_name, ma.average_list_price, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond / overall.average_across_media_types AS relative_average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.average_across_media_types IS NOT NULL
